text:
Maya: Heads up — the onboarding sampleapp is spiking 429s in staging and we're seeing duplicate webhooks downstream. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Jonah: Ugh. Seen similar when healthcheck pings get routed through the same path as user requests. Are those pings triggering side-effects?
Maya: Yeah, sampleapp's /ping endpoint goes through the same webhook pipeline (bad idea) and our SDK retries on 429 with a short full-jitter window. Result: two almost-identical requests land and create duplicate records.
Priya: Do we have telemetry showing identical payloads with different Idempotency keys?
InfraArchie: Logs show same payload, different idempotency header absent in most cases. The client library was only adding Idempotency-Key for POSTs, and our onboarding tutorial used GET for the check which didn't set it.
devex-bot: [alert] 2026-03-23T15:02:12Z 429 surge detected on staging: /v1/sampleapp/webhook (count=87, p95-retry-delay=320ms)
Jonah: Two quick options: 1) teach the sampleapp to use a non-side-effecting healthcheck path 2) make the SDK more conservative on 429 retries for endpoints flagged as "probe-like".
Maya: For quick fix we can patch the sampleapp to return 204 for health pings and bypass webhook forwarding. Longer-term: SDK change seems needed because real customers have edge cases.
Priya: Agreed. Proposal: add an opt-in header `X-Safe-Replay: true` that SDK sets when it detects an idempotent operation or user opts in. Backend can then dedupe within a short window and skip processing when present. Also add a small tweak to retry jitter behavior: default to decorrelated-jitter with a slightly larger base.
Jonah: I like `X-Safe-Replay`. Also add a sampleapp flag `--prewarm-no-forward` so onboarding doesn't route probes through user flows.
Maya: Here's a minimal Node snippet we can add to docs (inline):
```
// when creating a request, set idempotency + safe replay header
fetch('/v1/webhook', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Idempotency-Key': uuidv4(),
    'X-Safe-Replay': 'true'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
})
```
Priya: Nice. SDK change: default retry behavior diff: current full-jitter: sleep = rand(0, base * 2^n) vs decorrelated (https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/architecture/exponential-backoff-and-jitter/) — that should lower synchronized retry storms. Add a small cap and make the initial base 120ms instead of 50ms.
Jonah: We should also expose a flag in SDK `safeReplayStrategy: 'off' | 'light' | 'strict'` where `light` sets `X-Safe-Replay` and conservative jitter, and `strict` also enforces no retransmit for certain http verbs.
Maya: I'll open a tiny PR for sampleapp doc and patch (staging hotfix) — PR 4123.
InfraArchie: For backend, we can implement a short LRU dedupe keyed by payload fingerprint + `X-Safe-Replay` present. 2s window should catch most doubled deliveries without adding heavy state.
Priya: Can we add a telemetry flag to detect 'probe-like' requests automatically? heuristics: small payload (<500B), endpoint path contains ping/health, and user-agent matches sampleapp.
Jonah: Yeah but be careful: auto-detection can misclassify real low-volume requests. Make it off by default; enable in onboarding envs.
Maya: Action items:
- Maya: patch sampleapp to not forward prewarm pings (hotfix) — PR 4123 — rolling to staging now.
- Priya: draft SDK PR with `safeReplayStrategy` + decorrelated jitter defaults (target: next minor release).
- Jonah: add backend LRU dedupe prototype for `X-Safe-Replay` (2s window) and a telemetry flag for onboarding envs.
- InfraArchie: monitor staging for regressions and update the alert thresholds.
Jonah: I'll also add a short note to onboarding docs explaining why healthchecks must be idempotent and how to use the header.
Maya: Thanks team. If anyone hits the staging spike again ping @Jonah and I'll pause the sampleapp rollout. :thumbsup:
Priya: One more thought — add an opt-in sampleapp test in CI that simulates 429 at 100ms and verifies no duplicate side-effects when `X-Safe-Replay` is used.
Jonah: Great idea. That will prevent regressions.
Maya: OK closing thread after patch. Will post PR links once available.
devex-bot: [update] PR 4123 deployed to staging (canary=10%). Monitoring for 10m.
